metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean off-diagonal item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Higher indicates directional alignment, not definitive representation collapse or recommendation diversity. Null if fewer than two items exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean augmented positive-minus-negative logit over valid training positions; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of augmented positive-minus-negative logits; null if no valid positions were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid positions with margin below zero; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid positions with margin below 0.5; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Position totals for margins below 0.5 or zero. Category lists are empty because item category metadata is unavailable.
metric_definitions.recent_alpha: Direct unconstrained scalar, initialized to zero; may become negative.
metric_definitions.recent_valid_positions: Number of valid training positions used for branch diagnostics.
metric_definitions.recent_encoder_norm: Mean L2 norm of the masked backbone state before residual addition; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_branch_norm: Mean L2 norm of the normalized recent-item mean before scaling; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_scaled_branch_norm: Mean L2 norm of alpha times the recent branch; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_absolute_branch_margin_contributi: Mean absolute alpha-scaled branch contribution to the positive-minus-negative logit using the trained tied scoring function; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.existing_gradients_finite: Whether all currently retained parameter gradients are finite; null when no gradients are retained. Diagnosis performs no backward pass.
